text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty HIGH alert: cuda.mem.pressure on pool 'infer-pool-west2' (nvmlOOMProbe >= 90%). Hosts: gpu-47, gpu-49. PD incident: INC-8921. Auto-retries increasing.

alice_oncall: acked. I'm on it, will triage.

bob_sre: thx. grabbing nvml logs and tailing driver events. any immediate customer reports?

dave_support: getting a few 5xxs from customer 'GlowApps' — spike started ~2m ago, ~18% error rate on infer route. I can DM logs.

alice_oncall: running quick health check and pprof on the pool.

claire_infra: FYI I see k8s eviction pressure on node gpu-47: memory.available < 500MB, oom_kill count rising.

alice_oncall: running nvidia-smi on gpu-47 now:
```
$ ssh root@gpu-47 'nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used,memory.total --format=csv'
memory.used [MiB], memory.total [MiB]
15360 MiB, 16384 MiB
```

alice_oncall: processes look pinned, many long-lived kvcache sessions. suspect leaking kv cache on latest model variant.

bob_sre: can you soft-evict heavy sessions? try k8s rollout restart pod with label pool=infer-pool-west2 on the two hosts. keep one replica up.

alice_oncall: executing graceful restart on gpu-49 -> `kubectl rollout restart deployment/infer-worker -l pool=infer-pool-west2 --field-selector=spec.nodeName=gpu-49`

incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-8921 acknowledged by alice_oncall at 3345671240.

dave_support: customer impact update: GlowApps latency spikes to 8-12s, 18% 500s. Other customers minor error bumps. Opening interim status page.

bob_sre: if restart doesn't free enough memory, plan B is to scale down qps for model-x heavy routes or route to fallback smaller quantized variant. I can flip routing policy if needed.

alice_oncall: gpu-49 restarted, nvml memory back to 2GB used, pods rescheduled. Monitoring.

claire_infra: gpu-47 still high. no restart yet due to live sessions pinned to persistent sockets. we can force-drain but that'll drop in-flight queries. need approval.

dave_support: approve force-drain if it reduces customer 5xxs — customers are seeing real errors. hold on a final warning to customers before disruptive ops?

emma_custsuccess: prepping customer comms for GlowApps: 1) brief impact, 2) mitigation in progress, 3) ask to expect transient errors for next 10m. Sending now.

alice_oncall: escalating to second oncall for handoff if I need to step away. @bob_sre — can you take over if this becomes multi-node evac?

bob_sre: standby, will take handoff at 3345671275 if still active.

alice_oncall: initiating force-evac on gpu-47: `kubectl drain gpu-47 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force` (will cordon then evict).

claire_infra: performed cordon + force-evict, pods moved to gpu-52/gpu-53. nvml memory on gpu-47 dropped to 1.8GB then stable.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-8921 escalated to bob_sre at 3345671276 (on-call escalation).

bob_sre: picking up. running trace to confirm no residual memory leak on new pods.

bob_sre: quick check: new replicas starting with KV cache disabled for heavy model variant, memory stable. Applying config change to rollout across pool.

alice_oncall: good work team. I'll update the PD incident notes and mark timeframe for customer comms.

emma_custsuccess: posted status update to customers: 'We observed GPU memory pressure affecting infer endpoints; mitigation (pod restarts and routing to fallback models) is in progress. Errors reduced after mitigation; monitoring continues.'

incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-8921 resolved by bob_sre at 3345671295 (auto-close after stability window).

bob_sre: follow-ups: add kv cache eviction TTL for that variant, add alert suppression for quick restarts, and run a root-cause eval for leaked cache growth. I'll open a ticket.

alice_oncall: handing back to normal schedule — closing thread. :white_check_mark:
